dogecoin.text: @MysterEaze @BotOfDogecoin I honestly can't tell if your trolling me or not? In all seriousness people are making money off of #dogecoin  and it was never meant to be serious much less have actual use for something in the first place.

It's irritating to read these articles by finance experts talking about how a majority of these #cryptocurrencies are useless and won't be around in the future. #dogecoin was invented as a joke back in 2013, novelty use mostly. It's 0.27¢ a coin now.. The jokes on them really...
